At a glance

Challenge, approach, and result

Challenge

An existing page with search visibility that was not fully targeting the local swim team searches families were using.

Approach

Reviewed performance in Google Analytics and Semrush, researched and mapped new keywords, then updated the title tag, meta description, H1, H2s, and body copy.

Result

Two to three months later, organic traffic was up 9.4%, the page ranked for 188 keywords, and it held positions 2 to 7 for relevant Delaware swim team searches.
